<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, when applied to the target molecule (the alkene precursor), would form a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester in the forward reaction, matching the Still‑Gennari HWE transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
